title: Parent comparison dashboard from saved child results
scheduling: Future only. Excluded from current campaign and current fixing-agent implementation. No run until the feature is selected and qualified.

human_turns.message: Put both investigations into one dashboard so I can compare them.
Use the latest trend result, but keep the previous comparison available.

reply_protocol: Each user turn normally uses one or two natural lines. Let actual questions drive replies. Keep exact resource IDs, technical conditions and expected numbers in the private fixture/oracle, never in simulated human prose.

private_fixture.setup: An authorized parent Chat already owns two independent completed child investigations, with retained tables and exact original versions/runs. A later child result is supplied only for the refresh variant.
private_fixture.input_scope: Read only declared saved result tables from exact authorized children. No underlying child reruns, source replacements or new paid research implied.
variants: Two completed children with compatible measures and windows.
One failed or incomplete child; keep its state visible and preserve the successful sibling.
Null, empty or incompatible child result; no fabricated combined statistic.
Child publishes a newer result after parent dashboard is saved; parent pins do not change automatically.
Stale or duplicate parent save/run, reopening, old-result selection and unauthorized child references.

future_acceptance.expected: An explicitly requested parent comparison owns one primary Study lineage in the same conversation, keeping history and existing child relationships. Ordinary read-only comparison can remain Chat.

Exact child definition/revision/execution/table pins, units, windows, keys, nulls and failures remain traceable. Independently reconcile parent calculations and displayed claims with those saved rows.
The parent Chat-to-Study transition and attached children are clear in existing Contextual Intelligence/navigation patterns.
The combined dashboard uses existing result tables/charts and visibly preserves incomplete or incompatible evidence.
Parent history, selected results and input pins survive reload; a newer child output cannot silently rewrite the saved comparison.
Stale/duplicate actions preserve the accepted parent comparison and create no unintended child work.
Review actual source-to-result, numerical, UI and ownership evidence. Do not infer feature or scenario PASS from unit tests or a chat summary.

prerequisites: ENG-3174 selected for future work and shared ownership/type contract updated.
Reviewable UI/UX flow and canonical Product Pattern reconciliation before implementation.
A qualified source target with supported saved-result composition and exact cross-child input retention.
Readiness/account, fixture scope and budget frozen for a new campaign attempt.
non_goals: No immediate implementation or test execution.
No generic mailbox, unqualified parent-child steering, grandchildren or silent reparenting.
No automatic child reruns or live provider work.
No mutation of the frozen 28-case catalogue or historical grades.
authority_note: Human explicitly requested a future issue and a scenario pending that issue on 23 November 2026.
